answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 7 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 72 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. The ivory test is the live device, the mesa test is the locked stake, and the marble test is the graded history no template can fake.
